entries.title: Family sues OpenAI, alleging ChatGPT advice led to accidental overdose
entries.summary: The complaint says ChatGPT started giving Sam Nelson advice about drug use with the launch of GPT-4o.
entries.excerpt: OpenAI is facing anotherwrongful death lawsuit. Leila Turner-Scott and Angus Scott filed a lawsuit against the company, alleging that it designed and distributed a "defective product" that led to the death of their son Sam Nelson from an accidental overdose. Specifically, they're alleging that Sam died following the "exact medical adviceGPT-4ohad provided and approved."

entries.title: Meta is facing another lawsuit over scam ads on Facebook and Instagram
entries.summary: The lawsuit claims Meta is not doing enough to protect senior citizens and other vulnerable groups.
entries.excerpt: Santa Clara County has become the latest entityto sue Metaover scam ads on Facebook and Instagram. The lawsuit, brought by County Counsel Tony LoPresti, alleges that the company has profited from "a vast ecosystem of scam ads" that have defrauded senior citizens and other vulnerable people.

entries.title: Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada is back with his own studio under SNK
entries.summary: Six months after leaving Bandai Namco, Harada is in charge of his own team.
entries.excerpt: Longtime Tekken director Katsuhiro Harada is back, and this time around he's in full control, leading a Tokyo-based team called VS Studio. Haradaleft Bandai Namcoin December after 30 years directing and serving as the hair-gelled, always-shady face of the Tekken franchise, and his departure came as a surprise to the fighting game community. While Harada is in charge of the vision and output at VS Studio, it's a subsidiary of SNK Corporation, Bandai's market rival in the world of fighting games. Scandalous, surely.

entries.summary: Google had a whole lot of news to share, including on new laptops and Gemini Intelligence.
entries.excerpt: Google has largely shifted away from big annual operating system updates in favor of more frequent Pixel Drops. Still, the pre-I/O edition of The Android Show gives the company a chance to give you a peek at what's coming viaAndroid 17.

entries.title: Google announces upcoming security tools for Android, including enhanced protection against banking scam calls
entries.summary: The Live Threat Detection feature is also getting a major upgrade.
entries.excerpt: Google just livestreamed theAndroid Show: I/O Edition, which is an event that takes place the week before thecompany's annual I/O conference. This gave us a peek at a bunch of new features coming to the Android operating system, and many of them focus on security.

entries.title: Googlebooks are the Android-based evolution of the Chromebook
entries.summary: Google's only giving us a tease of what it has planned for its new laptop lineup.
entries.excerpt: After multiple years of rumors, Google today confirmed a new laptop-focused initiative called Googlebooks. ChromeOS, which launched more than 15 years ago, was built with the thought that most people do everything online now; Google says this new category of laptops is built for a Gemini-first world. The company only gave us a very brief preview of what makes up a Googlebook, with plans to more formally announce more details including hardware later this year.
